documents: The northbound railway service makes its final departure at 21:43 from platform seven. Rail passengers must validate their tickets before boarding the final train.
The municipal drinking-water report records arsenic at 12 micrograms per litre. This is a measured concentration in the water supply, not an annual production figure.
The national electricity statistics report installed solar generation capacity of 5120 megawatts. Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight, and these figures refer to installed power.
The central public library closes at 18:30 on Saturday. Borrowed books may be placed in the external return box after the staffed library has closed for the day.
The port manifest records a shipment of 7341 crates of machine parts. The quantity is measured in crates, rather than tonnes or the number of individual components.
Emperor penguins breed on Antarctic sea ice during the winter. Their young depend on stable ice until they develop the waterproof feathers needed for swimming.
The provincial hospital has opened a new pediatric wing with 291 beds. The construction project also includes a dedicated entrance for children and their families.
The local history museum entry ticket costs 17 euros for an adult visitor. Children under twelve can enter without paying when they are accompanied by a responsible adult.
